name: Enable all S3 Block Public Access settings
description: Ensure an S3 bucket blocks public access through ACLs and bucket policies.

remediation.summary: Enable all four S3 Block Public Access settings.
remediation.rationale: These settings help prevent public access through S3 ACLs and bucket policies.

potential_side_effects: Applications or users relying on public access may lose access.
Existing public-access-dependent workloads may be disrupted.
preconditions: Determine whether public access is intentionally required.

validation.method: Read the bucket Block Public Access configuration and confirm all four settings are true.

rollback.strategy: Restore the previously approved configuration through the established management mechanism.
rollback.warning: Do not automatically disable public-access protections as a rollback without explicit security review and approval.
